audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose said Lissandra 'keeps the fight at a distance your kit resents' and called her 'him' throughout.
audit.why: Backwards: Ice Shard is 725 and Ring of Frost is 450, both shorter than Hwei's paints. She has to close with Glacial Path, and she is female per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: Even at 5.5/10, 53.32% over 2,875 games. The difficulty is her level-6 CC chain, not her range.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Lissandra/Hwei/Hwei and matched the packet levelChart — including flattening her genuine level-6 spike.
audit.why: Pre-6 Hwei out-ranges everything she owns and Glacial Path is 24 seconds at rank 1. Level 6 is hers: Ring of Frost into Glacial Path into Frozen Tomb is a full chain. After first item her utility build stops trading with your burst.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side to Hwei, phases[3] stays Skill, phases[4].side to Lissandra, phases[5..6].side to Hwei, with each why rewritten to the row's verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Claw Marks (W)' used in four places for Ring of Frost, plus a nonexistent Hwei 'E stun' and 'Severalty (Q) wall'. Neither Frozen Tomb interaction was stated.
audit.why: Riot's data: Lissandra's W is Ring of Frost, a 450-range root on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Frozen Tomb self-cast makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing her. Hwei's E line is Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw — no stun.
audit.corrected: Real name used everywhere; the untargetable self-cast written in as a do-not-dump-your-combo rule, and Grievous Wounds attached to the self-heal.

audit.why: Glacial Path 24/21/18/15/12 at 1050, Ring of Frost 10 down to 8 at 450, Ice Shard 7 down to 3 at 725, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, with the Glacial Path downtime as the commit cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite Frozen Tomb healing her through chip.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into wants.you[1] and breakdown.late.
